description: Activate when: 'we have a strong product but keep losing on price', 'customers treat us like a commodity', 'how do we stop being compared to competitors', 'why aren't customers coming to us before they write the RFP', 'we want to define the category before someone else does'. Do NOT activate when: the customer's problem definition is fixed by regulation or physical constraint (e.g., fuel procurement); or the user is pre-product with no customer intelligence yet. More: deciqai.com/c/demand-leadership
